name: Smart Match
description: Safely identifies Jellyfin films and series whose folder or file names carry release-site watermarks or release tags. Builds a findings report from new scans and existing libraries, applies matches one at a time, in selected batches or (opt-in) automatically, and never renames or moves media files.
overview: Review and repair metadata matches from messy filenames.

versions.changelog: Initial release: continuous scan monitoring, existing-library audit, persistent findings report, selective and bulk apply, opt-in automatic matching and conditional rollback.
